name: Migration fee-friction reduction
hypothesis: Buy a confirmed demand breakout only when independently recomputed total trading friction falls below the registered threshold.
spec: Setup: A lower round-trip fee burden may alter participation after migration. Entry: Buy a confirmed demand breakout only when independently recomputed total trading friction falls below the registered threshold. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit on demand reversal, fee increase, or the intraday time limit. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
blocked_reason: needs launchpad migration events and pool state history (on-chain, not connected)
